mechanism: For r>=2, an initial modular integer polynomial phase of the complete native frequency only translates the logical least trit inside uniform-prior nuisance fibers. Compute/copy/uncompute and measure one derivative trit, remove the initial phase, run the original remaining receiver and translate its prediction. Mean success is exactly preserved for every fixed public label matrix.
research_decision: Do not promote an initial total-frequency polynomial chirp as the missing receiver. Partial-block polynomials, top-digit nonpolynomial phases and phases after noncommuting mixing remain specific unexcluded targets; none is an algorithm merely because this compiler does not apply.
falsifiers: A modular integer polynomial violates square-zero Taylor at r>=2.
The one-trit clean-workspace compiler changes complete uniform-secret mean success.
A root-one, top-digit nonpolynomial or partial-block phase is falsely compiled away.
The guarantee is promoted to pointwise secret success or to receivers with unaccounted additional secret-bearing input.

proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Review ensemble dephasing, the square-zero Taylor identity, derivative-only instrument and the sign of the decoder translation.
proof_obligations.PO-PRIOR: Uniform over every secret coordinate and high digit is essential. Mean-risk equivalence does not preserve each pure state or each fixed secret's success.
proof_obligations.PO-BATCH: The complete secret-bearing source batch used by the remaining receiver must be included in F. Additional same-secret states, workspace or query access require a new analysis.
proof_obligations.PO-CLEAN: Copy only the derivative trit and uncompute all scratch. Measuring total F or retaining its target high trit erases the useful coherence.
proof_obligations.PO-SCOPE: Only an initial integer polynomial of TOTAL F at r>=2 is removed. Partial blocks, nonpolynomial carries, other priors and interleaved mixing remain outside the reduction.
proof_obligations.PO-COST: Charge coefficient computation, public polynomial encoding, arithmetic and source copies. Finite exact MAP and full-prior replays are exponential calibration, not supplied efficient decoders.
proof_obligations.PO-NOVELTY: No novelty, efficient algorithm or generic quantum lower bound is claimed.
